name: Incense
overview: Scripture reveals that incense held a sacred role in Israelite worship, with God commanding Moses to make a special altar of acacia wood for burning incense (Exodus 30:1). Aaron, the high priest, was instructed to offer sweet incense every morning and evening, creating a perpetual aroma before the Lord as a symbol of continual prayer and atonement (Exodus 30:7-8). The formula for this incense was divinely prescribed, combining pure frankincense with other spices to form a holy and pure perfume, underscoring its sanctity and significance in approaching God (Exodus 30:34-36).
